{"consolidated_memory":"## Empty result set issues in search/query/rewriter.ts

Component: search/query/rewriter.ts (search side)
Common symptom: Empty result set in the query rewriter
Common repro: Search for a two word phrase containing a stop word
Common signal: A rewritten query with no clauses left
Test coverage: search/query/rewriter.test.ts (TypeScript)

THREE SEPARATE OCCASIONS:

### Occasion 1: [2026-06-16]
Trigger: Jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
Root cause: Schema drift between the migration and the model
Fix: Regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum
PR: #1930 on branch fix/empty-result-set-1
Outcome: Error rate dropped from 9.0% to under 5 per ten thousand

### Occasion 2: [2026-07-31]
Trigger: Payloads above roughly two megabytes
Root cause: Floating point rounding in the money path
Fix: Moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
PR: #2817 on branch fix/empty-result-set-2
Outcome: Flaky test went from 53 failures per hundred runs to zero

### Occasion 3: [2026-08-09]
Trigger: Sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
Root cause: Off-by-one in the slice bound
Fix: Corrected the bound and added a property test around it
PR: #8355 on branch fix/empty-result-set-3
Outcome: Alert stayed quiet for 45 consecutive days"}
